_comment: Schema reference for the 'jobs' Firestore collection. NOT a live Firestore document. Use as the canonical field-name reference for all phases.

jobId.description: Firestore auto-generated document ID. Also the key for the corresponding invoices/{jobId}.pdf in Storage.

customerPhone.description: Customer's WhatsApp phone number in E.164 format. Used for all subsequent WhatsApp messages (payment link, invoice, status updates).

pickupCoords.description: Customer's pickup location as sent via WhatsApp location pin.

destCoords.description: Customer's destination location as sent via WhatsApp location pin.

requestedTruckType.description: Customer's requested towing category: 'flatbed' (maps to fareCalculator serviceType 'flatbed') or 'pulling' (maps to fareCalculator serviceType 'standard').

distanceKm.description: Haversine straight-line distance in km from pickup to destination. Used for tier selection and Tier 3 commission formula. NOTE: this is the haversine distance, not the routed distance — the fare estimate applies road_curvature_factor on top.

pricingTier.description: Commission/booking-fee tier returned by the trusted Phase 2 calculator and fixed when the job is created.

bookingFeePaise.description: Platform booking fee charged to the customer in integer paise. Tier-based. This is the ONLY amount the platform collects from the customer — never the full tow fare.

driverCommissionPaise.description: Amount in integer paise deducted from the driver's wallet on job acceptance. Tier-based; Tier 3 uses the formula: tier3_driver_commission_base + (per_km_overage_rate * (distanceKm - long_distance_limit_km)).

estimatedFarePaise.description: Estimated full tow fare in integer paise — informational only, never collected by the platform. Shown to customer as 'collected directly by driver'. Calculated by fareCalculator using fare_formula.

status.description: Job state machine status. Starts at awaiting_payment. State transitions are enforced inside atomic Cloud Function transactions. The 'cancelled_system' status covers the no-driver-found case after the offer cascade is exhausted.

offeredTo.description: UID of the driver currently being offered this job. Used by the atomic accept-transaction to guard against double-assignment (checks job.status == 'offered' && job.offeredTo == driverId).

assignedDriver.description: UID of the driver who accepted the job. Set atomically when the driver accepts. Null until accepted.

channel.description: How the booking was initiated. 'whatsapp' = customer self-served via WhatsApp flow. 'phone' = co-owner took the booking by phone via Admin Panel (Phase 6).

createdByAdmin.description: Reserved for the Phase 6 Admin Panel phone-booking attribution. The current Phase 3 six-argument createJobAndQuote initializes this field to null and does not receive an admin UID.
createdByAdmin.writer: Phase 3 createJobAndQuote initializes null; Phase 6 must define the authenticated admin attribution write

razorpayPaymentLinkId.description: Razorpay Payment Link ID (plink_...) returned for the booking-fee payment.

razorpayPaymentLinkUrl.description: The Razorpay short_url returned when the Payment Link is created. Stored so payment reminders and retries can resend without contacting Razorpay again.

paymentLinkProvisioningOwner.description: Random owner token fencing recoverable Razorpay Payment Link provisioning.

paymentLinkProvisioningLeaseUntil.description: Expiry of the Payment Link provisioning owner; a stale claim may be reclaimed.

razorpayPaymentId.description: Razorpay payment ID received from the Razorpay webhook on payment success. Stored for refund operations (no-driver-found case).

paymentConfirmedAt.description: Timestamp when the successful booking-fee payment was verified and persisted.

invoiceNumber.description: Sequential GST invoice number (e.g. 'TDS-0001'). Assigned via atomic Firestore transaction on business_config.invoiceNumberCounter. Null until the booking fee payment succeeds and the invoice is generated.

invoiceUrl.description: Firebase Storage URL for the generated invoice PDF. Set once the PDF is uploaded. The PDF is also sent to the customer as a WhatsApp document — this URL is for admin reference.

invoiceSentAt.description: Timestamp written only after Meta accepts the outbound WhatsApp booking-fee invoice message. This is provider acceptance, not proof of recipient delivery; retries remain at-least-once.

invoiceStoragePath.description: Exact private Firebase Storage object path invoices/{jobId}.pdf.

invoiceIssueDateIst.description: Immutable invoice issue date in YYYY-MM-DD using Asia/Kolkata.

invoiceIssuedAt.description: Instant paired with invoiceIssueDateIst and reused on recovery.

invoiceWhatsAppMediaId.description: Meta media ID returned for the private PDF upload.

invoiceWhatsAppMessageId.description: Meta message ID returned when WhatsApp accepts invoice delivery.

invoiceSendOwner.description: Owner token fencing invoice delivery recovery.

invoiceSendLeaseUntil.description: Expiry of the recoverable invoice delivery claim.

offerExpiresAt.description: When the current offer to offeredTo expires. A Cloud Task is scheduled for this timestamp to trigger the offer-cascade logic. Never use in-function sleeps.

requestId.description: Client-generated UUID sent by the driver app when tapping ACCEPT JOB. Used as an idempotency key so duplicate accept calls (network retries) are deduplicated. Checked against processed_requests/{requestId}.
requestId.writer: Driver app (sent as parameter to accept Cloud Function)

cancelledBy.description: Who initiated the cancellation. 'system' = no driver found after cascade exhausted.

cancellationReason.description: Free-text reason for cancellation, if provided.

cancellationRequestedAt.description: Timestamp when the customer requested cancellation. Used to prevent race conditions with incoming payments.

razorpayRefundId.description: Razorpay refund ID received from the refund.processed webhook.

refundConfirmedAt.description: Timestamp when the refund.processed webhook successfully processed.

refundedAmountPaise.description: Customer booking-fee amount confirmed refunded by Razorpay for the no-driver-found case. This field does not represent a future driver-wallet credit.
refundedAmountPaise.writer: Cloud Function (Razorpay refund.processed webhook handler — Phase 3)

forfeitedAmount.description: Commission amount forfeited by the driver under the cancellation penalty ramp. Pure wallet ledger operation — no Razorpay call.

createdAt.description: When the job document was first created by createJobAndQuote.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Set on every Cloud Function write to the job doc.
updatedAt.writer: Cloud Function (any handler that touches this doc)
